notes: Butter: cut 54 flat models to 17 (global market brands Lurpak, Kerrygold, Président, Anchor, Land O'Lakes, Amul; CHOICE 2022 test leaders Kerrygold Pure Irish Salted 79%, Lurpak Slightly Salted and Meander Valley Salted Cultured 76%; regional leaders in Japan, Gulf, South Africa, Turkey, Chile, Brazil; one flavoured and two GI examples). Dropped the Turkish and South Asian SKU long tail (Eker, Enka, Taraklı, Teksüt, Torku, İtimat, İçim, Milma, Verka, Vita, Gowardhan, Heritage, Milky Mist, Akshayakalpa, Aarong, PRAN, Haleeb, Pelwatte, Kotmale), plus Connacht Gold, Colanta, Dina Farms, Bonnita, Paulista, Milbona, KCC, Piracanjuba, Soprole, Verónica, First Choice, Kerrygold Naturally Softer. PDO butters became archetypes with producers as versions; Lurpak range dropped (now a model). Elle & Vire not added (no page retrieved); Beurre d'Échiré has no versions because none were confirmed. Ghee: merged old Ghee and Clarified butter; Amul's five ghees are one model; smen, niter kibbeh, manteiga-da-terra are types; Şanlıurfa sadeyağı is an archetype (Urfa butter in the Ghee article). Spreadable butter: Lurpak Spreadable maker fixed to Arla Foods, duplicate range dropped, Anchor Spreadable added from the Anchor article. Which? spreadable test (Aldi Nordpak winner) not used: article fetch blocked (403).
